Who WeServe

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/IH5lrB4k12FnH4Mmj2v3fP8uCQ.png?width=2200&height=1467)

### Healthcare Organizations

Close care gaps and reduce readmissions with automated post‑discharge outreach, two‑way follow‑up, and EHR/FHIR integration.

[See Outcomes for Healthcare Organizations](https://gobloominghealth.com/healthcare-organizations-2)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/dtgdMzUWnmFe3d5ZfoRA6ocOtk.png?width=1882&height=1224)

### Government Agencies

Government agencies scale equitable engagement, monitor program impact across regions, and meet policy and grant reporting requirements.

[See Outcomes for Government Agencies](https://gobloominghealth.com/government-agencies-2)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/dBUItcZdim6CW4Pr4kGSBGvkU.png?width=2048&height=1103)

### Community Care Hubs

Community Care Hubs coordinate outreach across partners, close resource gaps, and centralize data for funder‑ready reporting and network performance.

[See Outcomes for Community Care Hubs](https://gobloominghealth.com/community-care-hubs-3)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/tj0zpLASUryXhmNop4XXUGpUJUU.png?width=2120&height=868)

### Community Based Organizations

• Social service providers delivering last‑mile support

• Includes Area Agencies on Aging, senior centers, and community programs

• Increase participation with multilingual outreach, reminders, and wellness check‑ins

[See Outcomes for Community Based Organizations](https://gobloominghealth.com/community-based-organizations-3)

How It Works

1

Design a care workflow in minutes

Build multi‑step journeys that AI executes at scale across voice, SMS and email. Include logic for language, eligibility, and follow‑ups.

2

AI-driven screening, navigation, and automated follow-ups

AI conducts needs assessments, recommends services, assists with navigation, and triggers referrals with closed‑loop tracking, working across voice, SMS, and email with multilingual support

3

Close the loop with automated resource matching

Tap a service provider directory to find in‑language, local resources and send warm referrals. Track completion and outcomes automatically.

[See Platform in Action](https://share.hsforms.com/1wPdVFhZCQqOBr6-tFNuVpQbp9wg)

NEW • AI‑assisted Medicaid and SNAP Recertification

A standout differentiator that helps Health Systems, Health Plans, and Government keep populations insured at scale.

Outcomes: Higher recertification and renewal rates. Reduced churn and administrative burden. Equitable access through multilingual voice and SMS.

Proof points: Lift in on‑time renewals. Reduced manual follow‑ups. Compliance‑ready audit trails and dashboards.

[Explore Recertification](https://gobloominghealth.com/social-care-renewal-ai-agent)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/aSTD2BPOn6vLuTbmxjFmKmu5Fns.png?width=2000&height=1545)

Platform Capabilities

### Engagement

Send broadcasts, appointment and program reminders, and wellness check‑ins. Two‑way messaging captures needs fast.

• Surveys and Wellness Check‑Ins

• Automated Appointment and Program

Reminders

• Emergency Broadcasts and Education

### Automation

Build once and automate across channels with segmentation, triggers, and workflows that save staff hours every week.

• Triggered Journeys

• Smart Send‑Time and Channel Failover

• Staff Notifications

• Voice/SMS work without internet

### Analytics

See what’s working and where support is needed. Track participation, outreach effectiveness, and equity metrics.

• Program Participation Dashboards

• Cohort and Language Insights

• Funder‑Ready Reports

### Interoperability

Connect to EHRs, CRMs, and data pipelines via FHIR, HL7, or API. Import/export rosters and outcomes securely. FHIR/HL7

• EHR and CRM Connectors

• SFTP and API

• Role‑Based Access

### Security

HIPAA compliant by design, with encryption in transit and at rest, role‑based access controls, audit trails, and BAAs available.

• HIPAA

• Encryption

• Access Controls

• Audit Trails
